data.title: Vivy · 无人小舞台的每日首唱
data.description: 游乐园角落的小舞台，观众席空空荡荡，她依然端正地站到定点、微笑、开唱；晨光落在白靴上——「用歌声让大家幸福」从不要求观众数量。
data.action: 游乐园角落的小舞台，观众席空空荡荡，她依然端正地站到定点、微笑、开唱
data.promptProse: Vivy stands precisely on her mark at the amusement park's small stage, smiling and singing toward rows of empty audience seats. Her opaque white-and-blue stage dress, shoulder coverage, earpiece and white boots remain clear. The medium portrait includes the platform edge and silent seats beyond. Morning light falls across her blue hair and boots, with the stage's low shadow crossing the ground and gentle reflected brightness on the dress's white panels.
